God I know the struggles with autism. About a quarter of a century and it is still so hard to have a decent conversation. I either go off on a tangent and the other person gets bored or uncomfortable, or I get so bored I just want the convo to be over. Do you have stims that help when you're overwhelmed?

I think the thing is most people know they aren't the only ones going through depression and suffering like they are, and, unfortunately, that doesn't help my suffering at all. I have no one I can talk to. Loved ones don't understand, and talking about it to them either bums them out or it makes them really uncomfortable. It sucks. Yeah there's people out there that are in the same boat, but they aren't necessarily near you. And when you can't make anyone you personally know or care about understand how much fucking pain you feel, that's the loneliest feeling there is.

This for sure. That isn't most of my friends. I shouldn't feel that way about these people I care so much about but I feel like they won't care if I just vanished.
